description: Defines table columns for restaurant data, including image, ID, name, vendor, email, address, status toggle, and action menu; manages restaurant status updates via GraphQL mutation with toast notifications.

methods.name: onHandleRestaurantStatusChange
methods.description: Handles toggling restaurant active/inactive status, calls GraphQL delete mutation, and shows success/error toast.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles GraphQL or network errors during mutation, shows error toast.
